messages.name: Umbrella Corp admin
messages.body: We voided 60 invoices in bulk and clients still got payment reminders for them.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: That's BUG-2200-03: a bulk void leaves scheduled reminders in place. It will be fixed in 2.2.1. For now, cancel the reminders from each client's Reminders tab.

messages.name: Umbrella Corp admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
